Package io.micronaut.guides.core.html

Class DefaultGuidePageGenerator

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.guides.core.html.DefaultGuidePageGenerator
All Implemented Interfaces:
FileGenerator, GuidePageGenerator
@Singleton public class DefaultGuidePageGenerator extends Object implements GuidePageGenerator
Default implementation of the GuidePageGenerator interface. This class is responsible for generating the HTML pages for guides.
